title: Det-LIME: Detector-Aware, Multi-Instance Local Interpretable Model-Agnostic Explanations for Automated Marine Mammal Detection
abstract: arXiv:2609.17479v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Despite the rapid uptake of black-box object detectors in marine mammal research and monitoring, explainability techniques are rarely integrated into conservation workflows. Furthermore, most classification-oriented explainability tools are ill-suited to detection tasks involving imagery of social organisms or those with colonial life histories, as they ignore multiple detections within a scene and produce single-instance outputs that blur evidence across individuals. These methods also generate low-resolution, often biologically irrelevant visuals, limiting their utility for debugging, targeted data augmentation, and refined data collection. translated_title: Det-LIME：面向海洋哺乳动物自动检测的检测器感知、多实例局部可解释模型无关解释方法
translated_abstract: 尽管黑盒目标检测器在海洋哺乳动物研究和监测中得到了快速应用，但可解释性技术很少被整合到保护工作流程中。此外，大多数面向分类任务的可解释性工具并不适用于涉及社会性生物或群体性生活史生物图像的检测任务，因为这些工具忽略了场景中的多个检测结果，产生的单实例输出会混淆不同个体之间的证据。这些方法还会生成低分辨率且通常与生物学无关的视觉结果，限制了它们在模型调试、针对性数据增强和精细化数据收集方面的实用性。我们提出了Det-LIME，这是一种检测器感知的、多实例的局部可解释模型无关解释（LIME）改进方法，通过结合逐检测加权、强调每个边界框附近区域的邻近核函数以及交并比（IoU）相关的（原文在此处截断）机制，生成针对特定实例且与边界框对齐的解释。
tldr: 提出Det-LIME，一种检测器感知的多实例LIME改进方法，可为海洋哺乳动物自动检测模型生成实例级、与边界框对齐的高质量可解释性说明，弥补了传统分类可解释性工具无法处理多目标检测的缺陷。
en_tdlr: We propose Det-LIME, a detector-aware, multi-instance adaptation of LIME that produces instance-specific, box-aligned explanations for automated marine mammal detection, addressing the limitations of classification-oriented explainability tools in multi-object detection scenarios.
